limitations: Whole Hellobike APK analysis exhausted Java heap. Original DEX slices were independently byte-compared against the APKs. Cross-DEX reference absence is bounded by the inspected slices.
A complete source status denotes REA extraction coverage, not runtime verification or absence of decompiler warnings. Smali fallbacks are retained without presenting them as Java.
Abstract ApiService methods have no implementation body. Original DEX annotations, returned types, VM calls and consumer callbacks together identify the endpoint.
Public H5 and native APK versions differ; H5 supplies only explicitly attributed protocol consumer evidence, not proof that every native flow is identical.

No unverified time, location accuracy, payment stock or vehicle-type predicate is retained as a cloud business rejection. Missing structural data and unimplemented transports still produce factual diagnostics.
Technical ownership, request correlation, serialization and uncertain-action recovery guards are local integrity protections, not official business restrictions.
